title: Follow the steps
subject: Careers

thread_tags.line: Thread tags: SMSC S/So (M/C: none); British Values IL/MR (D/RL/T: none).
thread_tags.rationale: S: reflect on a task attempt and support needed. So: listen, ask and respond during a work task. IL: choose a response mode, ask for help or pause. MR: give a person time to understand and ask a question without ridicule.

label: Public edition
objective_verbatim: Follow a two-step work instruction and check the result.
display_objective: Follow two work steps. Check the result.
approved_activity: Put picture instructions in order for a fictional packing task using safe classroom materials.
Complete the task, check it against the pictures and identify any help needed.
calendar_note: Year A. 16–20 November 2026. One 40-minute lesson. No day or clock slot inferred. Week 7 is assessing.
where_this_leads: This helps me follow instructions and check my work.
unit: Following instructions and asking for clarity
accreditation: The qualification and the accredited unit: staff confirm any mapping from actual work. No criteria or completion are inferred.
assessment: Weeks 1–6 are formative. Week 7 is the assessing lesson. Keep actual responses, support, gaps and next steps in the evidence record.

sources.note: The owner-approved standalone Careers outline is the weekly teaching source. Combined workbook rows supply context rather than substitute weekly objectives.
Background on independence, recognising jobs and taking responsibility. Generic wording is used. The raw workbook is not redistributed.

authoring_provenance.note: Newly authored tasks from the owner-approved Careers outline. Workbook cells supply context only. Paper rehearsal tasks, job cards and fixed replies are newly authored.

external_sources.note: Approval, curriculum context, template and authored visual provenance.

evidence.description: Sequenced instructions, the completed task and an observation recording accuracy and prompts.
evidence.status: not prefilled; actual response and support to be recorded

routes.Supported: Supported: read the two picture cards together, choose which comes first, then carry out both steps with prompts recorded.
routes.Independent: Independent: order both picture cards, pack the set and compare it with the final picture.
routes.Aspire: Aspire: check a separate mock pack with an extra or missing square, explain the error and correct it.

cases.text: Put one square next to the circle.
cases.next_step: The circle must already be in the tray. The completed set has one circle and one square side by side.

cases.text: Put one circle in the tray.
cases.next_step: The required picture-card order is B then A. Observe the actual order as well as the final set.

cases.text: A mock pack has one circle and two squares.
cases.next_step: Remove one square and recheck against the final picture. Use a separate mock pack for Aspire.

cases.text: A mock pack has one circle and no square.
cases.next_step: Add one square next to the circle and recheck. Do not quietly repair the learner’s own pack.

We Do: 5 minutes.
Teacher: A follows the second instruction. B adds an extra square; C leaves the pack incomplete. A final correct pack alone does not prove the order of actions, so observe the steps as they happen. Reteach with the two picture cards: a circle must already be present before a square can go next to it.
